issues.description: The problem specification (UML and description) requires SealSaloon.orderMeal to have a void return type, but the solution implementation declares orderMeal as returning boolean. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and the behavior they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification by changing the solution's orderMeal signature to 'public void orderMeal(Meal meal)' and remove the boolean return value (adjust internal logic accordingly), or alternatively update the problem statement/UML to accept a boolean return value if that was the intended design. Ensure the template and documentation use the same signature.
